results.title: VoxENES 2026: Benchmarking Generalization of Speech Spoofing Detectors Against LLM-Era TTS and Voice Conversion
results.snippet: Modern LLM-driven text-to-speech (TTS) and voice conversion (VC) systems produce synthetic speech that differs from the generators represented in many legacy spoofing benchmarks. This mismatch creates a temporal generalization gap that can overestimate detector robustness under real-world post-processing conditions. We bridge this gap by introducing VoxENES 2026, a bilingual (English and Spanish) benchmark of 53,628 audio samples generated using 10 contemporary speech synthesis methods and evaluated under 10 standardized post-processing conditions. results.title: Adaptive Control of Robot Manipulators With Uncertain Kinematics and Dynamics
results.snippet: In this paper, we investigate the adaptive control problem for robot manipulators with both the uncertain kinematics and dynamics. We propose two adaptive control schemes to realize the objective of task-space trajectory tracking irrespective of the uncertain kinematics and dynamics. The proposed controllers have the desirable separation property, and we also show that the first adaptive controller with appropriate modifications can yield improved performance, without the expense of conservative gain choice. The performance of the proposed controllers is shown by numerical simulations.

results.title: ROS-Causal: A ROS-based Causal Analysis Framework for Human-Robot Interaction Applications
results.snippet: Deploying robots in human-shared spaces requires understanding interactions among nearby agents and objects. Modelling cause-and-effect relations through causal inference aids in predicting human behaviours and anticipating robot interventions. However, a critical challenge arises as existing causal discovery methods currently lack an implementation inside the ROS ecosystem, the standard de facto in robotics, hindering effective utilisation in robotics. To address this gap, this paper introduces ROS-Causal, a ROS-based framework for onboard data collection and causal discovery in human-robot…

| ALOHA 2: Enhanced Low-Cost Hardware for Bimanual Teleoperation | 2024 | Stanford / Google DeepMind | GitHub Star 待核实 [4] | arXiv 预印本 (cs.RO) / CoRL 2024 [4] | 高 | ★★★★★ | [4] | 低成本双臂遥操作硬件与数据采集系统，推动全身遥操作数据收集与模仿学习策略训练，间接驱动 ROS 2 实时控制栈在真机上的工程化需求 [4] |

> **增量判断**：近两年核心增量集中在 **因果推理与 ROS 2 集成** [25] 及 **低成本全身遥操作硬件生态** [4]；**运动学求解器（Pinocchio/OCS2）、MoveIt 2 Servo、ROS 2 Control 实时回路（1-2kHz）在差分动力学/全身 MPC/接触丰富操作中的端到端基准对比仍缺乏系统性公开报告** [q1-finding-3] > 待核实。

## 2. 工业界与产品

### 2.2 生态成熟度现状

- **ROS 2 Control / MoveIt 2 商业级部署案例**：> 待核实（无公开系统性统计或第三方白皮书覆盖 2024-2026 量产项目） [q1-finding-3]
- **硬件本体原生 ROS 2 支持厂商列表**：> 待核实（缺乏权威名单） [q2-findings-empty]
- **商业化仿真-实机迁移管线（Sim2Real）产品化工具链**：> 待核实

---

## 3. 蓝海与缺口

| 缺口编号 | 描述 | 证据支撑 | 优先级 |
|----------|------|----------|--------|
| G1 | **ROS 2 Control 实时运动学/动力学求解器基准缺失**：Pinocchio、OCS2、MoveIt 2 Servo 在不同实时内核、不同本体上的 1-2kHz 闭环延迟、抖动、数值稳定性无统一基准 | [q1-finding-3] | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| G2 | **因果推理与运动控制栈深度融合**：因果感知的阻抗调整、动态运动基元选择、接触模式推理仍停留在框架演示 [25] 阶段，缺乏真机长周期鲁棒性验证 | [25] | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| G3 | **多智能体开放系统基准测试复现与参与机制失效**：MOASEI 2026 仅 1/8 队伍提交最终条目，反映基准维护、环境复现、激励机制均存在结构性缺口 | [16] | ⭐⭐⭐ |
| G4 | **中国工业机器人功能安全认证细节不透明**：具体标准版本（ISO 13849 PL d/e? ISO 10218?）、覆盖本体范围、认证机构、周期成本缺乏公开细节 | [20] | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |

> **蓝海判断**：G1 与 G2 为**高杠杆技术蓝海**——解决实时基准与因果-控制融合可直接提升具身智能真机部署可靠性；G3/G4 为**生态与合规蓝海**——亟需行业联盟或标准组织主导补齐。

---

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

### 4.1 核心瓶颈

| 瓶颈 | 表现 | 证据 | 严重度 |
